user.title: Add an auction site
user.description: Pick the site. The next page asks how to log in.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to {site} again
reauth_confirm.description: {site} no longer accepts the saved login. Fill in the same kind of login as when you set it up.

govauctions.title: GovAuctions login
govauctions.description: Log in to GovAuctions in your browser, then upload the cookies.txt file a cookie-export extension saves, or paste the Cookie header from the browser's Network tab. The login lasts about a year and renews itself.

macbid.title: Mac.bid login
macbid.description:
Recommended: your Mac.bid email and password. Home Assistant then has its own login and renews it every 30 minutes, without logging your browser out.

Or leave those empty and paste your browser's saved login instead (F12 → Storage/Application → Local Storage → https://www.mac.bid → copy the values of mac_auths and device_id). After pasting, log in again in your browser: Mac.bid only keeps one renewal chain per login.

macbid_code.title: Mac.bid verification code
macbid_code.description: Mac.bid doesn't know Home Assistant yet, so it sent a code to {where}. Type it here. After this, Home Assistant stays logged in on its own.

ebay.title: eBay developer keys
ebay.description: From developer.ebay.com, your Production keyset. App ID and Cert ID let Home Assistant look up items. Add your RuName (User Tokens, "Get a Token from eBay via Your Application") to also sign in, so your watchlist and bids are followed automatically.

data.extra_auction_ids: Items to follow (item numbers or ebay.com/itm links, optional)

ebay_signin.title: Sign in to eBay

data.signed_in_address: Address of the page you landed on

error.no_cookies: No cookies for this site were found in the file or text you gave.
error.invalid_auth: The site didn't accept that login. Check your email and password (or log in again in your browser and copy fresh values).
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the site. Try again in a minute.
error.no_input: Upload a cookies.txt file or paste your cookies.
error.macbid_no_input: Enter your email and password, or paste the browser's saved login.
error.macbid_need_device: With a pasted saved login, also paste its device_id.
error.macbid_bad_saved_login: That doesn't look like Mac.bid's mac_auths value. Copy the whole value (it starts with {).
error.macbid_bad_code: Mac.bid didn't accept that code. Check it, or start over to get a new one.
error.ebay_bad_keys: eBay didn't accept those keys. Check they're from the Production keyset (not Sandbox).
error.ebay_bad_signin: That sign-in didn't work. Paste the full address of the page eBay showed after signing in, within a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: This site is already set up.

init.title: GovAuctions settings
init.description: When to alert, where alerts go, and how often to check.

data.alert_max_bidders: Alert when OTHER active bidders are at most (you aren't counted)
data.active_window_minutes: Count anyone who bid within the last N minutes
data.stable_seconds: …and only after it stays that low for N seconds (0 = right away)
data.alert_max_price: Only alert below this price (0 = any price)
data.default_bid_limit: Default max bids per auction (0 = none)
data.notify_services: Send alerts to (phone push, Telegram, Alexa Media Player, ...)
data.notify_entities: Also send to notify entities (Telegram chats, Alexa Devices Announce/Speak, ...)
data.fast_interval_seconds: Check every N seconds while something you follow is live
data.idle_interval_minutes: Check every N minutes when nothing is live
data.extra_auction_ids: Extra auction IDs to follow (comma separated)
data.keep_ended_days: Keep ended auctions on the Auctions page for this many days
data.scan_point_packs: Check the site's point packs every hour and score them
data.weekly_budget_points: Weekly budget in points, Monday to Sunday (0 = none)

data_description.active_window_minutes: The site only shows the last 9 bids. Counting a few minutes back catches people who pause and jump back in.
data_description.stable_seconds: With 2 bidders an auction can end in seconds, so 0 alerts as soon as it qualifies.
data_description.notify_entities: Alexa gets a short spoken version; text targets like Telegram get the auction link.
data_description.alert_max_bidders: 1 = you against one other person. Also what auto-cancel/rebook call crowded: more than this is crowded.
data_description.keep_ended_days: Then they're removed, including their sensors. Auctions you stop following are kept too, marked 'no longer followed'.
data_description.scan_point_packs: Uses the site's own Packs filter. Shows them on the Point packs tab and can alert when a good one is open to join.
data_description.weekly_budget_points: Counts every bid you place, by hand or booked. When it's used up, auto-booking stops and the Book button refuses until Monday. Cancelling still works.

macbid_options.title: Mac.bid settings
macbid_options.description: When to alert, where alerts go, and how often to check.

data.ending_soon_minutes: Alert this many minutes before an auction ends (0 = off)
data.pickup_reminder_hours: Pickup reminder this many hours before the deadline
data.default_bid_limit: Default max bid per item, in dollars (0 = none)
data.notify_services: Send alerts to (phone push, Telegram, Alexa Media Player, ...)
data.notify_entities: Also send to notify entities (Telegram chats, Alexa Devices Announce/Speak, ...)
data.fast_interval_seconds: Check every N seconds in an item's last 15 minutes
data.idle_interval_minutes: Check every N minutes when nothing is ending soon (max 15)
data.keep_ended_days: Keep ended auctions on the Auctions page for this many days
data.extra_auction_ids: Extra Mac.bid lot IDs to follow (comma separated)
data.macbid_budget_dollars: Most dollars tied up in Mac.bid max bids at once (0 = no limit)

data_description.default_bid_limit: You get an alert when the price passes it. You can set it per item on the Auctions page.
data_description.notify_entities: Alexa gets a short spoken version; text targets like Telegram get the auction link.
data_description.keep_ended_days: Then they're removed, including their sensors. Auctions you stop following are kept too, marked 'no longer followed'.
data_description.macbid_budget_dollars: Counts max bids you've placed on items still live (winning or still in) plus scheduled late bids. Automatic and manual bids stop once a new max would go past it.

ebay_options.title: eBay settings
ebay_options.description: When to alert, where alerts go, and how often to check.

data.ending_soon_minutes: Alert this many minutes before an auction ends (0 = off)
data.default_bid_limit: Default max price per item, in dollars (0 = none)
data.notify_services: Send alerts to (phone push, Telegram, Alexa Media Player, ...)
data.notify_entities: Also send to notify entities (Telegram chats, Alexa Devices Announce/Speak, ...)
data.fast_interval_seconds: Check every N seconds in an item's last 15 minutes
data.idle_interval_minutes: Check every N minutes when nothing is ending soon (max 15)
data.keep_ended_days: Keep ended auctions on the Auctions page for this many days
data.extra_auction_ids: Extra eBay items to follow (item numbers or links)

data_description.default_bid_limit: You get an alert when the price passes it. You can set it per item on the Auctions page.
data_description.notify_entities: Alexa gets a short spoken version; text targets like Telegram get the auction link.
data_description.keep_ended_days: Then they're removed, including their sensors. Auctions you stop following are kept too, marked 'no longer followed'.

set_bid_limit.name: Set bid limit
set_bid_limit.description: Set the most bids you want to spend on one auction. You'll get an alert when you reach it, and no more 'few bidders left' alerts for it. 0 removes the limit.

auction_id.name: Auction ID
auction_id.description: The number in the auction's address.

limit.name: Bid limit
limit.description: Total bids for this auction, including ones already placed.

refresh.name: Refresh now
refresh.description: Check every followed auction right away.

book_bids.name: Book bids
book_bids.description: Book bids on an auction you're following, like the site's Book button. Spends points. Never books past the auction's bid limit or your balance.

auction_id.name: Auction ID
auction_id.description: The number in the auction's address.

max_price.name: Max price
max_price.description: Optional: the site stops bidding for you above this price.

cancel_booked_bids.name: Cancel booked bids
cancel_booked_bids.description: Cancel your booked bids on an auction. Unused points go back to your balance.

auction_id.name: Auction ID
auction_id.description: The number in the auction's address.

set_auto_booking.name: Set auto-booking
set_auto_booking.description: Turn automatic cancel/rebook on or off for one auction. Needs a bid limit on that auction first.

auction_id.name: Auction ID
auction_id.description: The number in the auction's address.

auto_cancel.name: Auto-cancel when crowded
auto_cancel.description: Cancel your booked bids when there are more bidders than your alert number.

auto_rebook.name: Auto-rebook when it thins out
auto_rebook.description: Book again when it's back down to your alert number and you have none booked.

rebook_mode.name: Rebook amount
rebook_mode.description: fixed = the amount below; remaining = however many were left when it auto-cancelled.

rebook_amount.name: Fixed rebook amount
rebook_amount.description: Bids to book each time in fixed mode.

max_price.name: Max price
max_price.description: Passed to the site so your booked bids stop above this price (0 = none).

place_bid.name: Place Mac.bid max bid
place_bid.description: Place a max bid (whole dollars) on a Mac.bid item you follow. Mac.bid raises your bid for you up to it. You pay if you win.

auction_id.name: Lot ID
auction_id.description: The Mac.bid lot id (shown on the card).

buyers_assurance.name: Add Buyer's Assurance
buyers_assurance.description: 5-business-day return guarantee; the price is on the item.

set_macbid_bidding.name: Set Mac.bid auto-bidding
set_macbid_bidding.description: off, or late (place your max N seconds before the end). Needs a max bid on the item.

assurance.name: Add Buyer's Assurance to the late bid
assurance.description: Adds it when the late bid is placed.

search_now.name: Run saved searches now
search_now.description: Runs your saved searches on every site now (they also run daily at the time set on the Auctions page).
